hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 500 ms, replacing a flat/descent-monotone removal-savings ranking with a multiplicative-gate score (load-fill gate emphasizing near-capacity routes, depot-eccentricity gate emphasizing far routes, mild demand gate) combined with stagnation-inverted rank power (sharp exploitation early, flattening as stagnation_ratio -> 1) will improve mean objective beyond the current SBS 16.0201 (session_r0002) with the largest absolute gains concentrated in the weakest archive regimes: capacity_level=tight (12 instances), size=100 (12), depot_style=eccentric (12), demand_dist=uniform (12), and spatial=clustered (8), while first_feasible_ms stays ~2-3 ms so no instance becomes exhausted or failed.

next_search_advice.direction: Evolve score_ruin_nodes toward a multiplicative-gate + adaptive-rank-power ruin priority that targets the archive's weakest regimes on dev_24 (capacity_level=tight, size=100, depot_style=eccentric, demand_dist=uniform, spatial=clustered): score_i = |removal_savings_i| / scale * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist, then rank-power sharpen with p = p_low + (p_high - p_low) * f(stagnation_ratio, iter_frac). Concretely: gate_load = (route_load / capacity) ^ a with a ~ 1.0-2.0 so tight-capacity instances preferentially ruin the fullest routes (where the load constraint binds and reinsertion freedom is smallest); gate_depot = 1 + b * (mean depot distance of the route / global mean depot distance) with b ~ 0.5-1.0 so eccentric-depot instances spend ruin budget on far, high-latitude routes instead of near-depot clusters; gate_demand = (demand_i / mean_demand) ^ c with c ~ 0.5 to slightly favor multi-customer reshuffles over unit-demand churn; gate_rdist = sigmoid-like squash of route_dist relative to the incumbent mean so short routes are not over-cycled. Stagnation coupling is inverted vs worst-only removal: p_high (~2.5-3.0, near-pure worst removal, exploitation) at low stagnation and p_low (~1.0-1.3, flatter, more diverse node picks) as stagnation_ratio -> 1, so the loop escapes clustered-instance local optima that a monotone worst-removal ranking cannot. All state arrays treated read-only, fully deterministic tie-breaking, output length n finite. Keep the LNS skeleton, deterministic Regret-2 reinsertion, intra_2opt and R2R acceptance untouched so any gain is attributable to the ruin hook alone.
